items.question: What procedure produces a circular fire-pit from the previously measured portion?
premises: One part is to be placed outside the existing layout.
The placed part serves as the instrument for rotation.
Rotation by that measure yields a circular form.
items.inference: Therefore, placing one part outside and rotating by it produces a circular fire-pit.
uncertainties: The exact referent of tena, whether the part itself or the radius defined by it, is contextually implied.
items.plain_english: Having placed one part outside, one should rotate by that measure to make the fire-pit circular.
